_comment: Stardew Valley Objects.xnb item NAMES, translated from the Japanese (ja-JP) source text -- not a copy of the official English localization. Migrated from the earlier flat "key": "English (reading)" reference format by tools/segment-data/migrate_names.py, so that SegmentDataLoader can read them. That migration left every name as a single segment covering the whole string; a hand pass has since split the multi-word ones, so 526 of the 756 names now carry real word segments (アメシストの指輪 -> アメシスト / の / 指輪). The remaining 230 are single lexical items -- one-word names like 木材 or ドングリ, fish and mineral names, and lexicalized kanji compounds like 黒曜石 and 三葉虫 -- and are deliberately left whole.
